system.description: Once per turn, when you take the Attack action, you gain 1 Discipline for each attack made as part of the Attack action. Attacks made as part of a weapon property such as Multiattack or Light, does not count for this Kata. If you gained Discipline as a result of the Discipline class feature by casting a Bukijutsu with the Chain keyword already this turn, you cannot gain Discipline by taking the Attack action in the same turn. You cannot use Disciplined Maneuvers in the same turn you use this Kata.

roll.note: Once per turn, taking the Attack action: 1 for each attack of the action (not extra attacks from Multiattack or Light). Not in a turn you regained Discipline from a Chain Bukijutsu, or used Disciplined Maneuvers.
